docs: Stats content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of two to four figures, each with a value, a label and an optional note. One object is valid in every stats layout.

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

items.docs: the figures, in the order they are shown

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

value.docs: the figure as it is shown (12k, 99.9%, 4.8)

description.docs: a short note under the label; empty: none
